blocks.html:
Press boxes in a building, room or space used for assembly purposes shall be on an accessible route
   Exceptions:
      1.   An accessible route shall not be required to press boxes in bleachers that have a single point of entry from the bleachers, provided that the aggregate area of all press boxes for each area of sport activity is not more than 500 square feet (46.5 m 2 ).
      2.   An accessible route shall not be required to free-standing press boxes that are more than 12 feet ( 3657.6 mm) above grade provided that the aggregate area of all press boxes for each area of sport activity is not more than 500 square feet (46.5 m 2 ).
